title: Evolution's private laboratory
text: {{1}} the Horn of Africa lies Socotra, an island {{2}} plants are found nowhere else on Earth. {{3}} strange do the dragon trees look — umbrellas of blood-red wood on a bare trunk — {{4}} early visitors suspected each one had been planted by hand. Scientists have called {{5}} the Galápagos of the Indian Ocean, and the label fits: isolated for {{6}} of years, the island let its life evolve undisturbed, and {{7}} dragon trees grow in the wild anywhere else on Earth. Now goats, development and cyclones are threating the strange forests, and conservationists are racing to protect {{8}} before the laboratory closes for good.

gaps.hint: preposition: ___ the Horn of Africa lies
gaps.explanation: 'Off the coast/Horn' — position in the sea near: Off.

gaps.hint: relative: an island ___ plants are found
gaps.explanation: 'Whose' links the island to its plants.

gaps.hint: adverb: ___ strange do the trees look
gaps.explanation: Fronted 'So … that' triggers inversion: So strange do they look.
The result clause of 'So strange that'.
Object pronoun referring to the island: called it.
'For millions of years' — the long duration.

gaps.hint: determiner: ___ dragon trees grow anywhere else
gaps.explanation: 'No' negates the noun; 'not' cannot precede 'dragon trees'.
Object pronoun referring to the forests: protect them.
